purpose: Reconstruct only observable-traceable RX J2129 baryonic inputs on the four frozen dynamics bins, quantify shared covariance, and expose rather than fill missing components before any gravity response is evaluated.

selection_blinding.pre_freeze_disclosure: Before this exact rule was frozen, the catalog row nearest the BCG, four sources within 5 arcsec, and two sources just outside 5 arcsec were inspected. No aggregate satellite mass, membership count, acceleration bound, baryonic profile, or gravity residual had been calculated.
selection_blinding.consequence: Treat the satellite audit as disclosed engineering rather than a fully blind science result; do not tune membership or uncertainty thresholds after execution.

cosmology.lineage: Tian et al. 2020 adopted cosmology; used only for angular-to-physical coordinate conversion

analysis_bins.center_definition: arithmetic midpoint of each frozen semimajor-axis annulus

published_bcg_baseline.nuisance_covariance: M_total and R_e treated as independent because no covariance is published; both remain shared across every radial bin
published_bcg_baseline.source_interpretation: The paper text and Equation 6 define the Cooke mass as total M_total. The CDS byte description inconsistently appends M*(<Rad); the primary equation and prose control this reconstruction.
published_bcg_baseline.known_shape_obstruction: Tian reports a fitted Sersic index n=2.70 but uses a Hernquist approximation to an n=4 profile. No uncertainty on n, PSF model, GALFIT configuration, or BCG/ICL decomposition is published. Cooke derives the mass from MAGPHYS using SDSS ugriz Petrosian and WISE profile-fit photometry. The independently queried DR18 row fixes the r-band Petrosian flux aperture at 2 times 9.373521 arcsec, but deblending, bandpass, and component-assignment differences still require an aperture nuisance when normalizing a new HST BCG/ICL split. This is a numeric published baseline but not a completed BCG-shape likelihood.

cooke_mass_aperture.definition: All SDSS Petrosian-band fluxes use the circular aperture 2 times the r-band Petrosian radius.
cooke_mass_aperture.remaining_nuisance: Cooke combines SDSS Petrosian fluxes with WISE profile-fit photometry in MAGPHYS, and the SDSS child deblend is not an HST BCG/ICL component assignment. The HST fit must normalize within this measured aperture and propagate a deblend/bandpass sensitivity rather than treating the Cooke mass as an aperture-free total.

gas_anchor.source: Donahue et al. 2014 Chandra profile as transcribed by Tian et al. 2020
gas_anchor.allowed_inference: For radii below the anchor, cumulative gas mass is bounded only by 0 <= Mgas(<r) <= Mgas(<14.3 kpc) under monotonicity. For radii above it, the anchor supplies a lower bound but no finite upper bound.
gas_anchor.forbidden_inference: Do not fit or assume a beta, power-law, NFW, hydrostatic, or lens-calibrated gas profile from this single anchor.

satellite_catalog_rule.catalog_scope: all Molino RX J2129 sources retained in the homogeneous 16-band footprint
satellite_catalog_rule.photometric_possible_member_rule: When no secure spectroscopic redshift exists, retain the source if the published 95 percent first-peak interval [zb_Min_1, zb_Max_1] contains z_cluster; do not cut on Odds or Chi2.
satellite_catalog_rule.secure_spectroscopic_nonmember_rule: A quality 0 or 1 spectroscopic redshift outside the velocity window overrides a coincident photometric interval.
satellite_catalog_rule.mass_uncertainty_status: conservative project nuisance width, not a catalog-published per-source uncertainty; therefore insufficient for strict readiness
satellite_catalog_rule.effect_diagnostic: Report member counts and projected stellar-mass sums. Do not replace off-center galaxies by a centered spherical mass or declare them negligible from a point-mass acceleration singularity.
